Test_Objective: Verify modal layout: title, recipient field (*), editor toolbar, content textarea, hashtag field (*), image upload, anonymous toggle, footer Hủy/Gửi
Steps:
1. Open send-kudos modal
2. Compare against design
Expected_Result: Layout matches design spec

Test_Objective: Verify recipient search shows placeholder and dropdown arrow
Steps: 1. Observe recipient field
Expected_Result: Placeholder "Tìm kiếm" with dropdown arrow

Test_Objective: Verify content textarea placeholder
Steps: 1. Observe content textarea
Expected_Result: Placeholder "Hãy gửi gắm lời cám ơn và ghi nhận đến đồng đội tại đây nhé!"

Test_Objective: Verify mention hint always shown under textarea
Steps: 1. Observe area under textarea
Expected_Result: Hint "Bạn có thể ""@ + tên"" để nhắc tới đồng nghiệp khác" shown

Test_Objective: Verify "+ Hashtag" and "+ Image" buttons with "Tối đa 5" notes
Steps: 1. Observe hashtag and image sections
Expected_Result: "+ Hashtag" and "+ Image" buttons shown, each with "Tối đa 5" note

Test_Objective: Verify "Gửi" disabled when required fields empty, enabled when all filled
Steps:
1. Open modal with empty required fields
2. Fill recipient, content, hashtag
Expected_Result: "Gửi" disabled initially; enabled once required fields filled

Test_Objective: Verify typing filters the Sunner autocomplete and selecting populates the field
Steps:
1. Type part of a name
2. Select a result
Expected_Result: List filters by keyword; field populated with selected Sunner

Test_Objective: Verify recipient is required and must be a valid Sunner
Steps:
1. Select a valid Sunner and check
2. Leave empty and try to submit
Expected_Result: Valid selection accepted; empty shows red border + error and blocks submit

Test_Objective: Verify content is required
Steps:
1. Enter content and check
2. Clear content and try to submit
Expected_Result: Non-empty accepted; empty blocks submit

Test_Objective: Verify at least 1 hashtag is required
Steps:
1. Add 1 hashtag and check
2. Remove all tags and try to submit
Expected_Result: 1 tag accepted; 0 tags blocks submit with required error

Test_Objective: Verify no more than 5 hashtags can be added
Steps:
1. Add 5 hashtags
2. Attempt to add a 6th
Expected_Result: 5 accepted; adding a 6th is prevented

Test_Objective: Verify adding via dropdown creates a chip and "x" removes it
Steps:
1. Click "+ Hashtag" and add a tag
2. Click chip "x"
Expected_Result: Chip added then removed

Test_Objective: Verify Bold/Italic/Stroke/Number/Quote toggle formatting
Steps:
1. Select text
2. Toggle each format button
Expected_Result: Formatting applied then removed on toggle

Test_Objective: Verify Link opens URL dialog and inserts a link
Steps:
1. Click Link
2. Enter URL and confirm
Expected_Result: URL dialog opens; link inserted into content

Test_Objective: Verify "@ + name" shows mention suggestions
Steps: 1. Type "@" then a name
Expected_Result: Mention suggestion list appears; selecting inserts the mention

Test_Objective: Verify "+ Image" adds a thumbnail and "x" removes it
Steps:
1. Click "+ Image" and pick a file
2. Click thumbnail "x"
Expected_Result: Thumbnail added then removed

Test_Objective: Verify max 5 images and "+ Image" hides at 5
Steps: 1. Add 5 images
Expected_Result: 5 thumbnails shown; "+ Image" button hidden

Test_Objective: Verify enabling anonymous reveals the anonymous-name field
Steps:
1. Toggle anonymous on
2. Toggle off
Expected_Result: On reveals anonymous-name field; off hides it

Test_Objective: Verify "Hủy" closes the modal and discards changes
Steps:
1. Enter some data
2. Click "Hủy"
Expected_Result: Modal closes; changes discarded; nothing sent

Test_Objective: Verify a valid form submits, shows loading, and closes on success
Steps:
1. Fill required fields
2. Click "Gửi"
Expected_Result: Form validates and submits; loading shown; modal closes on success
